service.en: Import permit for live animals and birds
service.ur: زندہ جانوروں اور پرندوں کی درآمد کا اجازت نامہ
service.ml: ജീവനുള്ള മൃഗങ്ങളെയും പക്ഷികളെയും ഇറക്കുമതി ചെയ്യാനുള്ള പെർമിറ്റ്

about: Get approval to bring live animals or birds into the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official MOCCAE service page on the checked date. MOCCAE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Import permit for live animals and birds. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The permit is valid 90 days and the shipment is inspected on arrival
Animals must be identified by a microchip, ring or ear tag, with some exceptions
Shipping must be direct from the exporting country unless the ministry approves a transit
The importing facility needs a licence for animal care activities
documents: Release: attested veterinary health certificate from the exporting country
Certificate of origin for commercial consignments
Laboratory certificate where the exporting country requires one
fees: AED 10 per sheep or goat released, AED 20 per cow, buffalo or camel
AED 1 per ornamental bird with a minimum of AED 200 per consignment
channels: Quarantine centres at ports and airports
